description:
About our brand and products:

Lotza is The Soda Made to Party™ — a better-for-you party soda you can drink on its own or mix with alcohol.

I started Lotza because the beverage space is filled with drinks that optimize our workouts, our energy, and our gut health. But what about our fun?

The way we celebrate — the alcohol, junk food, late nights — beats us up, forcing us to choose between having fun and feeling good. Lotza’s here to fix that.

It’s low sugar, made with clean ingredients, and includes functional benefits that help support your body while you’re out there living your best life. Adaptogens to boost your mood while you sip. And electrolytes and antioxidants to help clean up the aftermath.

What makes us different:

Instead of throwing our budget at Bezos and Zuckerberg, we’re growing Lotza by supporting young, creative people like yourself in growing your careers (and wallets).

This program is designed for students who want real-world marketing experience, flexible paid work, with a brand they’re actually excited to represent.

We’re building Lotza by investing in real people, not just ads.

How affiliates can earn:

There are two ways to get involved; you can do one or both.

Affiliate sales:
Earn $5 for every 12-pack sold through your affiliate link.

Content:
Earn $20 per video we use on our social channels.
Earn $100 bonus for high-performing videos (10,000+ views).

Events & demos:
Earn $10/hour for working tastings, pop-ups, and demos.
Earn $2 per pack sold at events.

Plus: free Lotza, merch, and giveaways.

How to promote us:

Content creators:
Create short-form content like TikToks and Reels, help tell the Lotza story in your own voice, and earn commission through your unique affiliate link.

Events & demos:
Be the face of the brand in real life — work tastings, pop-ups, and retail demos.

Other information:

You don’t need a huge following. You don’t need prior marketing or sales experience.

We’re looking for people who are social, reliable, creative, curious, and who want hands-on experience with a fast-growing consumer brand.

Paid • Flexible • Real Experience
Content • Events • Or Both
